## Summary
- update the installed Sepo agent infrastructure from self-evolving/repo@60c1cd5
- refresh agent workflows, prompts/actions, runtime source, tests, and docs
- add generated-output ignores for .agent/dist/ and .agent/node_modules/
- preserve the existing Quartz/site GitHub assets such as deploy.yml, Dependabot, issue templates, and PR template

## Install audit
| Area | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Source revision | self-evolving/repo@60c1cd5 |
| Target branch | main |
| Existing agent install | Present; updated in place |
| .agent/ | Re-synced, excluding generated/dependency outputs |
| .github/actions and .github/prompts | Re-synced from Sepo |
| .github/workflows/agent-*.yml and test-scripts.yml | Updated from Sepo |
| Target-owned .github files | Preserved: deploy.yml, dependabot.yml, issue templates, pull_request_template.md |
| .skills/ and AGENT.md | Not copied; not requested |
| agent/memory | Already exists remotely; do not reinitialize |
| agent/rubrics | Not present remotely; initialize only if rubric steering is wanted |

## Validation
- git diff --check
- git diff --cached --check
- npm --prefix .agent ci
- npm --prefix .agent run build
- npm --prefix .agent test

## Post-merge notes
- At least one model provider secret is still required; this repository currently has CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN configured.
- For Vercel deployments that reject agent-authored commits, set repository variables AGENT_COMMITTER_NAME and AGENT_COMMITTER_EMAIL to a GitHub identity that has access to the Vercel project.
- Existing agent/memory branch should be reused. Run Agent / Rubrics / Initialization only if an agent/rubrics branch is desired.
title: Update Sepo agent infrastructure
